packageRules.description: Limit this trial to the GPUI family.
Group GPUI family updates for manual compatibility review.
prBodyNotes: GPUI Kit is patched locally at `vendor/gpui-kit` for hot reload. Refresh that copy from the proposed upstream release and preserve the `hot-reload` feature forwarding (unless upstream now provides it). A manifest bump alone is not a complete upgrade; check for Cargo patch or lockfile errors.
Before merging, run the workspace tests and lint checks, verify native Settings window close/reopen on macOS, and smoke-test `./dev`. Automerging is disabled.
